raw_segments.text: Edward the Duke of York, the Earl of Suffolk, Sir Richard Ketley, Davy Gamm, Esquire, none
else of name, and of all other men but five and twenty.
O God, thy arm was here, and not to us but to thy arm alone ascribe we all, when, without
stratagem, but in plain shock and even play of battle, was ever known so great and little
loss on one part and on the other.
Take it, God, for it is none but thine.
